options.A: Panchayat elections are conducted under Article 243K and municipal elections under Article 243ZA, both by the State Election Commission
options.B: Panchayat elections are conducted under Article 243I and municipal elections under Article 243Y, both by the State Finance Commission
options.C: Panchayat elections are conducted by the Election Commission of India and municipal elections by the State Election Commission
options.D: Local body elections are conducted by the Union Public Service Commission

questions.explanation: Panchayat elections are conducted under Article 243K and municipal elections under Article 243ZA, both by the State Election Commission.
questions.source: Local_Government.pdf - Section B, D and G

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the financial powers of local bodies is correct?

options.A: Local bodies cannot levy any taxes
options.B: State Legislatures may authorise Panchayats and Municipalities to levy, collect and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls and fees; assign State revenues; provide grants-in-aid; and establish funds, as prescribed by State law
options.C: Local bodies are funded only through donations
options.D: Local bodies cannot receive grants-in-aid from the State Government

questions.explanation: Article 243H for Panchayats and Article 243X for Municipalities enable State Legislatures to authorise local bodies to levy, collect and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls and fees; assign State revenues; provide grants-in-aid; and establish funds, as prescribed by State law.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the State Finance Commission is correct?

options.A: It is constituted under Article 280 every fifth year
options.B: It is constituted under Article 243I every fifth year to review the financial position of Panchayats and, under Article 243Y, also of Municipalities
options.C: It is a permanent body with a fixed term of ten years
options.D: It conducts elections to local bodies

questions.explanation: Article 243I requires the Governor to constitute a Finance Commission every fifth year to review the financial position of Panchayats. Article 243Y provides that the same State Finance Commission also reviews the financial position of Municipalities.
questions.source: Local_Government.pdf - Section B, D and G

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the State Election Commission is correct?

options.A: The State Election Commissioner is appointed by the President
options.B: The State Election Commissioner is appointed by the Governor and has constitutionally protected conditions of service and removal
options.C: The State Election Commission is a temporary body constituted every five years
options.D: The State Election Commission conducts elections to the State Legislative Assembly

questions.explanation: Article 243K provides that the State Election Commissioner is appointed by the Governor and has constitutionally protected conditions of service and removal. The State Election Commission conducts Panchayat and municipal elections, not State Legislative Assembly elections.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243O is correct?

options.A: It provides for the State Finance Commission
options.B: It bars court interference in specified electoral matters relating to Panchayats; delimitation laws cannot be questioned in court in the manner barred by the Article, and Panchayat elections can be challenged only through an election petition presented as provided by State law
options.C: It provides for reservation of women
options.D: It provides for the powers of Gram Sabha

questions.explanation: Article 243O bars court interference in specified electoral matters relating to Panchayats. Delimitation laws cannot be questioned in court in the manner barred by the Article, and Panchayat elections can be challenged only through an election petition presented as provided by State law.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243Y is correct?

options.B: It provides that the State Finance Commission constituted under Article 243I also reviews the financial position of Municipalities and makes recommendations to the Governor on municipal finances
options.C: It provides for reservation in Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243Y provides that the State Finance Commission constituted under Article 243I also reviews the financial position of Municipalities and makes recommendations to the Governor on municipal finances.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Gram Sabha is correct?

options.A: It is the elected executive body at the village level
options.B: It consists of persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village within the area of a village-level Panchayat and is the foundational forum for direct participation in rural local governance
options.D: It is a committee of the Zilla Panchayat

questions.explanation: Gram Sabha is the body consisting of persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village within the area of a village-level Panchayat. It is the foundational forum for direct participation in rural local governance. It is recognised under Article 243A, and defined in Article 243(b).

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Karnataka Panchayati Raj system is correct?

options.A: Gram, Taluk and Zilla Panchayats are independent sovereign governments
options.B: They are constitutionally recognised institutions of local self-government, but their powers, functions, finances and administrative arrangements operate within the Constitution and State legislation
options.C: They are field offices of the State Government
options.D: They are controlled directly by the Union Government

questions.explanation: Gram, Taluk and Zilla Panchayats are constitutionally recognised institutions of local self-government, but their powers, functions, finances and administrative arrangements operate within the Constitution and State legislation. They are not independent sovereign governments.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Mayor and Municipal Commissioner is correct?

options.A: The Mayor is the executive administrative head and the Municipal Commissioner is the political head
options.B: The Mayor is the elected or otherwise selected political head/presiding figure of a Municipal Corporation under the applicable State law; the Municipal Commissioner is the executive administrative head
options.C: Both are appointed by the State Government
options.D: Both are elected by the municipal council

questions.explanation: The Mayor is the elected or otherwise selected political head/presiding figure of a Municipal Corporation under the applicable State law. The Municipal Commissioner is the executive administrative head. Their respective powers depend on the governing statute.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the elected municipal council and the municipal commissioner is correct?

options.A: The elected council is the executive and the commissioner is the elected representative
options.B: The elected council provides representative decision-making and political oversight within its statutory powers; the Commissioner is the chief executive or administrative officer responsible for implementing municipal decisions and administering the municipal establishment under the applicable law
options.D: The commissioner is appointed by the council

questions.explanation: The elected council provides representative decision-making and political oversight within its statutory powers. The Commissioner is the chief executive or administrative officer responsible for implementing municipal decisions and administering the municipal establishment under the applicable law.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the role of a municipal councillor is correct?

options.A: A councillor serves as the chief executive of the municipality
options.B: A councillor represents a municipal ward, participates in council meetings and committees, raises local issues, scrutinises budgets and proposals, and helps communicate residents' needs to the municipal administration

questions.explanation: A councillor represents a municipal ward, participates in council meetings and committees, raises local issues, scrutinises budgets and proposals, and helps communicate residents' needs to the municipal administration.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Gram Sabha's relationship with the Gram Panchayat in Karnataka is correct?

options.A: The Gram Sabha is the elected executive body and the Gram Panchayat is the body of voters
options.B: The Gram Sabha is the body of registered voters of the relevant village area, whereas the Gram Panchayat is the elected executive local body; Gram Sabha meetings provide a forum for public participation, review of works, discussion of local priorities and social accountability under State law
options.C: Both are elected bodies with identical functions
options.D: The Gram Panchayat appoints the Gram Sabha members

questions.explanation: The Gram Sabha is the body of registered voters of the relevant village area, whereas the Gram Panchayat is the elected executive local body. Gram Sabha meetings provide a forum for public participation, review of works, discussion of local priorities and social accountability under State law.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Panchayat finances in Karnataka is correct?

options.A: Panchayats are funded only through Central Government grants
options.B: Panchayats may be supported through local taxes, fees and other revenues authorised by State law, assigned State revenues, grants-in-aid, and transfers recommended through the State Finance Commission framework under Articles 243I and 243H
options.C: Panchayats cannot levy any local taxes
options.D: Panchayats are funded only through donations from residents

questions.explanation: Panchayat finances in Karnataka may be supported through local taxes, fees and other revenues authorised by State law, assigned State revenues, grants-in-aid, and transfers recommended through the State Finance Commission framework under Articles 243I and 243H.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243A is correct?

options.A: It provides for reservation of seats in Panchayats
options.B: It recognises the Gram Sabha and allows the State Legislature to provide by law for its powers and functions at the village level
options.C: It provides for the State Finance Commission
options.D: It provides for the duration of Panchayats

questions.explanation: Article 243A recognises the Gram Sabha and allows the State Legislature to provide by law for its powers and functions at the village level.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243J is correct?

options.A: It provides for reservation of seats in Panchayats
options.B: It allows the State Legislature to make provisions by law for maintenance of Panchayat accounts and their audit
options.C: It provides for the State Finance Commission
options.D: It provides for the duration of Panchayats

questions.explanation: Article 243J allows the State Legislature to make provisions by law for maintenance of Panchayat accounts and their audit.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243V is correct?

options.A: It provides for reservation in Municipalities
options.B: It provides that a person must have attained 21 years of age to be qualified for election as a member of a Municipality
options.D: It provides for the duration of Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243V provides that a person must have attained 21 years of age to be qualified for election as a member of a Municipality.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243S is correct?

options.A: It provides for reservation in Municipalities
options.B: It provides for Ward Committees in Municipalities with a population of three lakh or more; State law provides for their composition and territorial area, which may consist of one or more wards
options.C: It provides for the duration of Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243S provides for Ward Committees in Municipalities with a population of three lakh or more. State law provides for their composition and territorial area, which may consist of one or more wards.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243Q is correct?

options.A: It provides for reservation in Municipalities
options.B: It provides for three types of Municipalities: Nagar Panchayat for a transitional area, Municipal Council for a smaller urban area, and Municipal Corporation for a larger urban area; industrial townships may be specified in the circumstances provided by the Article
options.C: It provides for the duration of Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243Q provides for three types of Municipalities: Nagar Panchayat for a transitional area, Municipal Council for a smaller urban area, and Municipal Corporation for a larger urban area. Industrial townships may be specified in the circumstances provided by the Article.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243D is correct?

options.A: It provides for reservation of seats for SCs and STs in proportion to their population in the Panchayat area, and reservation of not less than one-third of the total seats for women, including women belonging to SCs and STs; not less than one-third of chairperson offices at each level are also reserved for women
options.B: It provides for reservation of 50 per cent of seats for women in all Panchayats
options.C: It provides for reservation only for SCs and STs
options.D: It provides for reservation of chairperson offices only for SCs and STs

questions.explanation: Article 243D provides reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in proportion to their population in the Panchayat area, and reservation of not less than one-third of the total seats for women, including women belonging to SCs and STs. Not less than one-third of chairperson offices at each level are also reserved for women. State law may provide reservation for backward classes.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243T is correct?

options.A: It provides for reservation of seats for SCs and STs in proportion to their population in the municipal area and reservation of not less than one-third of the total seats for women, including SC/ST women; not less than one-third of chairperson offices are reserved for women
options.B: It provides for reservation of 50 per cent of seats for women in all Municipalities
options.C: It provides for reservation only for SCs and STs
options.D: It provides for reservation of chairperson offices only for SCs and STs

questions.explanation: Article 243T provides reservation of seats for SCs and STs in proportion to their population in the municipal area and reservation of not less than one-third of the total seats for women, including SC/ST women. Not less than one-third of chairperson offices are reserved for women. State law may provide reservation for backward classes.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243E is correct?

options.A: Every Panchayat continues for five years from the date appointed for its first meeting unless sooner dissolved under law; elections to reconstitute it must be completed before expiry of its term
options.B: Every Panchayat continues for six years
options.C: Every Panchayat continues for three years
options.D: Every Panchayat continues for four years

questions.explanation: Under Article 243E, every Panchayat continues for five years from the date appointed for its first meeting unless sooner dissolved under law. Elections to reconstitute it must be completed before expiry of its term.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243U is correct?

options.A: Every Municipality continues for five years from the date appointed for its first meeting unless sooner dissolved under law; elections must be completed before expiry, and after premature dissolution, elections must ordinarily be completed within six months, subject to the short-remainder exception
options.B: Every Municipality continues for six years
options.C: Every Municipality continues for three years
options.D: Every Municipality continues for four years

questions.explanation: Under Article 243U, every Municipality continues for five years from the date appointed for its first meeting unless sooner dissolved under law. Elections must be completed before expiry; after premature dissolution, elections must ordinarily be completed within six months, subject to the short-remainder exception.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243I is correct?

options.A: It requires the Governor to constitute a Finance Commission every fifth year to review the financial position of Panchayats and recommend principles for sharing State revenues, grants-in-aid and measures to improve their financial position
options.B: It requires the President to constitute a Finance Commission every fifth year
options.C: It provides for reservation in Panchayats
options.D: It provides for the duration of Panchayats

questions.explanation: Article 243I requires the Governor to constitute a Finance Commission every fifth year to review the financial position of Panchayats and recommend principles for sharing State revenues, grants-in-aid and measures to improve their financial position.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243H is correct?

options.A: It enables State Legislatures to authorise Panchayats to levy, collect and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls and fees; assign State revenues to them; provide grants-in-aid; and establish Panchayat funds, as prescribed by State law
options.B: It provides for reservation in Panchayats
options.C: It provides for the duration of Panchayats
options.D: It provides for the State Election Commission

questions.explanation: Article 243H enables State Legislatures to authorise Panchayats to levy, collect and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls and fees; assign State revenues to them; provide grants-in-aid; and establish Panchayat funds, as prescribed by State law.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243X is correct?

options.A: It enables State Legislatures to authorise Municipalities to levy, collect and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls and fees; assign State revenues; provide grants-in-aid; and establish municipal funds, as prescribed by State law
options.B: It provides for reservation in Municipalities
options.C: It provides for the duration of Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243X enables State Legislatures to authorise Municipalities to levy, collect and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls and fees; assign State revenues; provide grants-in-aid; and establish municipal funds, as prescribed by State law.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243K is correct?

options.A: It vests the superintendence, direction and control of preparation of electoral rolls and conduct of Panchayat elections in the State Election Commission; the State Election Commissioner is appointed by the Governor and has constitutionally protected conditions of service and removal
options.B: It vests election powers in the Election Commission of India
options.C: It provides for reservation in Panchayats
options.D: It provides for the State Finance Commission

questions.explanation: Article 243K vests the superintendence, direction and control of preparation of electoral rolls and conduct of Panchayat elections in the State Election Commission. The State Election Commissioner is appointed by the Governor and has constitutionally protected conditions of service and removal.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243ZA is correct?

options.A: It vests the superintendence, direction and control of preparation of electoral rolls and conduct of all municipal elections in the State Election Commission referred to in Article 243K
options.B: It vests election powers in the Election Commission of India
options.C: It provides for reservation in Municipalities
options.D: It provides for the State Finance Commission

questions.explanation: Article 243ZA vests the superintendence, direction and control of preparation of electoral rolls and conduct of all municipal elections in the State Election Commission referred to in Article 243K.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243ZD is correct?

options.A: It requires a District Planning Committee in every State district to consolidate plans prepared by Panchayats and Municipalities and prepare a draft development plan for the district as a whole
options.B: It provides for the Metropolitan Planning Committee
options.C: It provides for reservation in Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243ZD requires a District Planning Committee in every State district to consolidate plans prepared by Panchayats and Municipalities and prepare a draft development plan for the district as a whole.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Article 243ZE is correct?

options.A: It provides for a Metropolitan Planning Committee to prepare a draft development plan for a metropolitan area, taking account of plans prepared by Municipalities and Panchayats within that area and matters of common interest
options.B: It provides for the District Planning Committee
options.C: It provides for reservation in Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243ZE provides for a Metropolitan Planning Committee to prepare a draft development plan for a metropolitan area, taking account of plans prepared by Municipalities and Panchayats within that area and matters of common interest.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of local body tier and level in Karnataka?

options.B: Taluk Panchayat - Village level

questions.explanation: In Karnataka, Gram Panchayat is at the village level, Taluk Panchayat at the taluk/intermediate level, and Zilla Panchayat at the district level.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of urban local body and area type in Karnataka?

options.B: Municipal Council - Smaller urban area

questions.explanation: Nagar Panchayat is for a transitional area, Municipal Council for a smaller urban area, and Municipal Corporation for a larger urban area.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of Panchayat tier and its function in Karnataka?

options.B: Taluk Panchayat - Coordination of Gram Panchayat plans and programmes
options.D: Gram Panchayat - Supervision of Taluk Panchayats

questions.explanation: Taluk Panchayat functions include coordinating Gram Panchayat plans and programmes. Gram Panchayat handles village-level functions such as sanitation; Zilla Panchayat handles district-level planning and coordination.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of Article and subject under the 73rd Amendment?

options.B: Article 243B - Gram Sabha

questions.explanation: Article 243C deals with the composition of Panchayats. Article 243A deals with the Gram Sabha, Article 243B with the constitution of Panchayats, and Article 243D with reservation in Panchayats.
questions.source: Local_Government.pdf - Quick Article and Schedule Revision

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of Article and subject under the 74th Amendment?

options.B: Article 243R - Types of Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243S deals with Ward Committees. Article 243Q deals with types of Municipalities, Article 243R with composition of Municipalities, and Article 243T with reservation in Municipalities.
questions.source: Local_Government.pdf - Quick Article and Schedule Revision

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of Article and subject under the 73rd Amendment?

options.B: Article 243G - Powers and responsibilities of Panchayats

questions.explanation: Article 243G deals with powers and responsibilities of Panchayats. Article 243E deals with duration of Panchayats, Article 243I with State Finance Commission, and Article 243K with Panchayat elections.
questions.source: Local_Government.pdf - Quick Article and Schedule Revision

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of Article and subject under the 74th Amendment?

options.B: Article 243W - Powers and responsibilities of Municipalities

questions.explanation: Article 243W deals with powers and responsibilities of Municipalities. Article 243U deals with duration of Municipalities, Article 243Y with the State Finance Commission's review of municipal finances, and Article 243ZA with municipal elections.
questions.source: Local_Government.pdf - Quick Article and Schedule Revision

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of Article and subject under the 73rd Amendment?

options.B: Article 243J - State Finance Commission

questions.explanation: Article 243H deals with Panchayat taxation and funds. Article 243J deals with maintenance of Panchayat accounts and audit, Article 243O with bar on court interference in electoral matters, and Article 243A with the Gram Sabha.
questions.source: Local_Government.pdf - Quick Article and Schedule Revision

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct matching of Article and subject under the 74th Amendment?

options.B: Article 243Z - Municipal elections

questions.explanation: Article 243X deals with municipal taxation and funds. Article 243ZA deals with municipal elections, Article 243ZD with the District Planning Committee, and Article 243ZE with the Metropolitan Planning Committee.
questions.source: Local_Government.pdf - Quick Article and Schedule Revision

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Eleventh Schedule is correct?

options.A: It lists 18 subjects for devolution to Panchayats
options.B: It lists 29 subjects that may be devolved to Panchayats by State law
options.C: It lists 47 subjects for devolution to Panchayats
options.D: It lists 12 subjects for devolution to Panchayats

questions.explanation: The Eleventh Schedule lists 29 subjects that may be devolved to Panchayats by State law.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Twelfth Schedule is correct?

options.A: It lists 29 subjects for devolution to Municipalities
options.B: It lists 18 subjects for possible devolution to urban local bodies
options.C: It lists 47 subjects for devolution to Municipalities
options.D: It lists 12 subjects for devolution to Municipalities

questions.explanation: The Twelfth Schedule contains 18 subjects for possible devolution to urban local bodies.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Karnataka Panchayati Raj system is correct?

options.A: The Gram Panchayat is the body of registered voters and the Gram Sabha is the elected executive body
options.B: The Gram Sabha is the body of registered voters and the Gram Panchayat is the elected executive body; Gram Sabha meetings provide a forum for public participation, review of works, discussion of local priorities and social accountability
options.C: Both Gram Sabha and Gram Panchayat are elected bodies
options.D: The Gram Panchayat appoints the Gram Sabha members

questions.explanation: The Gram Sabha is the body of registered voters of the relevant village area, whereas the Gram Panchayat is the elected executive local body. Gram Sabha meetings provide a forum for public participation, review of works, discussion of local priorities and social accountability under State law.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the classification of urban local bodies in Karnataka is correct?

options.A: Town Municipal Councils and City Municipal Councils are both municipal councils but apply to different classes of urban areas under State law; their classification depends on statutory criteria and government notifications
options.B: Town Municipal Councils are rural bodies and City Municipal Councils are urban bodies
options.C: City Municipal Councils are under the Union Government and Town Municipal Councils are under the State Government
options.D: There is no difference between Town Municipal Councils and City Municipal Councils

questions.explanation: Both are municipal councils, but they apply to different classes of urban areas under State law. Their classification depends on statutory criteria and government notifications; their exact population or revenue thresholds should be checked against the current amended law and notification.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the functions of urban local bodies in Karnataka is correct?

options.A: Urban local bodies have no role in urban planning
options.B: Urban local body functions may include urban planning, regulation of land use and building construction, roads and bridges, water supply, sanitation, solid waste management, public health, street lighting, parks, fire services, slum improvement, poverty alleviation, public amenities and registration of births and deaths, subject to State devolution
options.C: Urban local bodies are responsible only for collecting property tax
options.D: Urban local bodies are responsible only for maintaining law and order

questions.explanation: Urban local body functions may include urban planning, regulation of land use and building construction, roads and bridges, water supply, sanitation, solid waste management, public health, street lighting, parks, fire services, slum improvement, poverty alleviation, public amenities and registration of births and deaths, subject to State devolution.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 73rd and 74th Amendments is correct?

options.A: Both Amendments inserted the same Part and Schedule
options.B: The 73rd Amendment inserted Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule; the 74th Amendment inserted Part IXA and the Twelfth Schedule
options.C: The 73rd Amendment inserted Part IXA and the Twelfth Schedule; the 74th Amendment inserted Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule
options.D: Both Amendments inserted Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule

questions.explanation: The 73rd Amendment inserted Part IX (Articles 243-243O) and the Eleventh Schedule (29 subjects) for Panchayats. The 74th Amendment inserted Part IXA (Articles 243P-243ZG) and the Twelfth Schedule (18 subjects) for Municipalities.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about reservation for women in Panchayats and Municipalities is correct?

options.A: The Constitution mandates 50 per cent reservation for women in all local bodies
options.B: The constitutional minimum is not less than one-third of seats for women, including seats reserved for women belonging to SCs and STs; State laws may provide a higher percentage, as Karnataka has done with 50 per cent in Panchayat Raj Institutions
options.C: There is no constitutional reservation for women in local bodies
options.D: Reservation for women is only for chairperson offices

questions.explanation: The constitutional minimum is not less than one-third of seats for women, including seats reserved for women belonging to SCs and STs. State laws may provide a higher percentage. Karnataka has provided 50 per cent reservation for women in Panchayat Raj Institutions through State legislation.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the tenure of Panchayats and Municipalities is correct?

options.A: Panchayats have a five-year term but Municipalities have a three-year term
options.B: Both Panchayats and Municipalities ordinarily have a five-year term; elections must be completed before expiry, and after premature dissolution elections must ordinarily be held within six months, subject to the exception where the remainder of the term is less than six months
options.C: Both Panchayats and Municipalities have a six-year term
options.D: The tenure of local bodies is determined by the Union Government

questions.explanation: Both Panchayats and Municipalities ordinarily have a five-year term. Their elections must be completed before expiry, and after premature dissolution elections must ordinarily be held within six months, subject to the constitutional exception where the remainder of the term is less than six months.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the State Election Commission and State Finance Commission is correct?

options.A: The State Election Commission recommends local-body financial devolution and the State Finance Commission conducts elections
options.B: The State Election Commission conducts Panchayat and municipal elections; the State Finance Commission reviews local-body finances and recommends fiscal devolution and grants

questions.explanation: The State Election Commission conducts Panchayat and municipal elections. The State Finance Commission reviews local-body finances and recommends fiscal devolution and grants.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Gram Sabha and Gram Panchayat is correct?

options.A: Gram Sabha is the elected body and Gram Panchayat consists of all voters
options.B: Gram Sabha consists of all persons registered in the electoral rolls of the village area; Gram Panchayat is the elected village-level local-government institution
options.C: Both are elected bodies with identical functions
options.D: Gram Sabha is at the taluk level and Gram Panchayat is at the district level

questions.explanation: Gram Sabha consists of all persons registered in the electoral rolls of the village area; Gram Panchayat is the elected village-level local-government institution.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.topic: Zilla Panchayat vs District Planning Committee
questions.question: Which of the following statements about Zilla Panchayat and District Planning Committee is correct?

options.A: Zilla Panchayat is a planning body and District Planning Committee is a rural local-government institution
options.B: Zilla Panchayat is a rural local-government institution at district level; the District Planning Committee is a constitutional planning body under Article 243ZD that consolidates rural and urban local plans for the district as a whole
options.D: Zilla Panchayat is an urban body and District Planning Committee is a rural body

questions.explanation: Zilla Panchayat is a rural local-government institution at district level. The District Planning Committee is a constitutional planning body under Article 243ZD that consolidates rural and urban local plans for the district as a whole.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about wards and population thresholds is correct?

options.A: The Constitution prescribes exact ward numbers for each Karnataka municipality
options.B: The Constitution provides the broad framework; detailed classification, ward delimitation and local-body composition are determined by State legislation, rules and government notifications, subject to constitutional requirements
options.C: Ward numbers are determined by the Election Commission of India
options.D: Population thresholds are fixed by the Union Government

questions.explanation: The Constitution provides the broad framework. Detailed classification, ward delimitation and local-body composition are determined by State legislation, rules and government notifications, subject to constitutional requirements.

questions.subject: Local Government
questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Eleventh and Twelfth Schedules is correct?

options.A: The subjects in both Schedules are automatically transferred to local bodies
